title: Restoring tapes at the end of a round
statement: Let $k,n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $x$ be a finite binary input, let $c$ be a configuration of a $k$-tape machine with states indexed by $\{0,\ldots,n\}$, and let $a$ be an action. Choose binary words $\mathrm{table},\mathrm{before},\mathrm{tail},\mathrm{word},\mathrm{pre}$ and a Boolean flag $\ell$, with $\mathrm{table}=\mathrm{before}$ followed by $\mathrm{tail}$. The round machine runs from the table-tail configuration based on the post-action configuration $a(c)$, with the table head at $|\mathrm{before}|$ and the summary head at $2+|\mathrm{word}|$, to the configuration based on $a(c)$ with both auxiliary heads at $0$ and the exit label determined by $\ell$. It takes $|\mathrm{tail}|+|\mathrm{table}|+|\mathrm{word}|+15$ steps and satisfies the round-span property.
hypotheses_covered: Natural numbers $k,n$ and finite binary input $x$
Binary words table, before, tail, word, and output prefix
Table is the concatenation of before and tail
